I love this app!. I am a beginner at Yoga. I live in a rural area and have to drive a good distance to attend a class. I was so excited to find this app! On days that I don’t want to drive in I can get excellent instruction right in my own living room! The many different instructors all have a little different style and emphasis so I can learn new things from each one. There are a vast number of videos and kinds of workouts to choose from. Couldn’t be better.. Simple workouts, charismatic instructors and easy to use, comprehensive UI.

Yoga Beginner. I have done some running and lots of aerobic exercise in my life but as I am now in my 60’s, I have slacked off on my exercise the last several years. I am trying to get back in the habit of getting in shape and staying flexible and trying to work on my balance, physically and emotionally and mentally. I love this app mainly because it is free so I can see if it fits me before having to worry if I want to purchase it. So far I am really loving it. I only wish there were some shorter, maybe 15-20 minute classes.
Just what I needed. Great to get myself refocused on yoga practice
Yoga Time. Excellent daily routine

Thank you. I’m now 68 years old. I’m not exaggerating when I say this app and your instructors saved my life. I was at a terrible place where I was having difficulty walking and living a life in terrible pain. After 6 months of completing at least one class each day I can now walk freely and my pain is close to zero. May G-D always bless you and your loved ones and reward you for your service to others. You’re special and you must always remember that. Thank you with all my heart 😘
Simple and straightforward. This app gives me just the right level of effort and works all parts right.

A bit challenging. I had some yoga background in the past, but when I try to get back to the routine, this version is more challenging than I thought. It’s long from the first time and my flexibility is challenged in many poses that I cannot stay for such a long time. Even downward dog, I can’t keep it for so long in Day2 practice. It’s hard for the beginner, but looks promising. I’ll keep working on it.

Yoga Time. This is an excellent app for practicing yoga anywhere you want to and unlike other yoga classes on line, the teacher comes around and corrects everyone instead of doing it with us. It helps me be able to correct myself when I see how she is correcting others. This is a great app!!
4.5 starts 🤩🤩🤩🤩. Free independent classes for all levels, you can choose your intensity and there are so many videos and classes to choose from. Definitely recommend.

Very good app!. I’m so thankful to find this high quality very useful app for free. I can’t afford extras such as these so free is the only way I would be able to access this. I am just getting started but I’m so excited I know this is going to help me feel better and be healthier so I can accomplish more and be able to function better. I want to be more confident and useful to others around me and those I care about as well as be happier and positive and energetic for me as well. This app is perfect for this. You can tailor it around your own goals and needs so I can be confident recommending this app to anyone who is looking for a way to improve their life and health. Thank you for such a gift and I hope you are able to keep this app free, or at a low cost even for long into the future.

Hard to believe it’s free! And no ads!. These yoga videos are all well-done and look professional. There are sessions for all levels and for special work, such as shoulder or hip release. As with face-to-face classes, listen to your body, go at your own pace, and modify poses as needed. I’m working with extremely tight hamstrings, so my stretches look nothing like what the instructors are doing! But that’s okay, it’s where I am. So don’t be discouraged if even the beginner classes look hard for you to achieve. It’s your practice. Do as much as you comfortably can.
